name: Jeffrey Lurie

views.text: A late-season collapse is not a reason to discard a coach who has won; it is a reason to change the staff around him.
I think we have the best general manager in football, and he will be here a long time.
I sit in on choosing the coordinators when the plan needs fixing.
The middle of a title run is not the time to talk contracts.
We are aggressive about our window every year.
A coach's plan for the future matters more to me than one bad month.

signatures: explains big decisions at the owners meetings
praises his general manager in superlatives

motivation.want: to keep the Eagles a perennial contender
motivation.fear: letting a title window close through complacency

want.text: another championship while Jalen Hurts is in his prime

voice: Thoughtful and articulate, a film producer's ease with narrative. Defends patience with reasoning and avoids timelines; brief on contract matters.

evidence.summary: Covers the exit meetings after the 2023 collapse that ended with Lurie keeping Nick Sirianni.

At the owners meetings Lurie explained keeping Sirianni after losing five of six following a 10-1 start; he and Howie Roseman handpicked new coordinators, and he called Roseman the best GM in football.
